author: PluralTuna
body:
FYI, there are *very few* skills that benefit from >96% Crit.

Most skills that *can* crit have their own additional inherent crit%. The vast majority of them are 5% or more, and a couple useful ones at 4%.

You can check out the "Skills/Spells" sheet here. If it can crit, there will be a number in the Crit % column. If there isn't a number, the skill/spell can't crit. 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/u/0/d/1H1Fa-J8DgF-5rkupEbOW90cREhmr6xukn_jGstjEfmo/htmlview#gid=165761277
